newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle $64 in moderate trade-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle $64 in moderate trade-USDA.

text.p: Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady.
Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 64.00, pen North Plains 64.25. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 64.00.
Sales reported on 13,000 slaughter steers and 5,400 heifers following weekly movement of 94,100.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
